# AgentDock

AgentDock is a small TypeScript SSE adapter for compiled LangGraph graphs. The
application builds and owns the agent, providers, tools, authentication,
authorization, and checkpointer lifecycle.

## Documentation

- [Install](https://agentdock-ai.vercel.app/docs/installation): dependencies and graph compatibility.
- [Quickstart](https://agentdock-ai.vercel.app/docs/quickstart): createAgent and Agentdock.
- [Interrupt and resume](https://agentdock-ai.vercel.app/docs/approvals): approval middleware and checkpointed continuation.
- [Events](https://agentdock-ai.vercel.app/docs/events): streaming and event reducer.
- [HTTP ReAct example](https://agentdock-ai.vercel.app/docs/example): Node server and tools.
- [API reference](https://agentdock-ai.vercel.app/docs/api-reference): serving methods and ownership.
- [Migration](https://agentdock-ai.vercel.app/docs/migration): move from the former AgentDock runtime APIs.

- [Agentdock UI](https://agentdock-ai.vercel.app/docs/ui): install editable React chat components with the published CLI.

## Packages

- [`@agentdock-ai/agentdock`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@agentdock-ai/agentdock): serve compiled graphs with SSE.
- [`@agentdock-ai/contracts`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@agentdock-ai/contracts): event contract and reducer.
- [`@agentdock-ai/react`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@agentdock-ai/react): React store, hooks, and stream helpers for the UI.
- [`@agentdock-ai/ui-core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@agentdock-ai/ui-core): framework-independent UI state and stream primitives.
- [`@agentdock-ai/agentdock-ui`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@agentdock-ai/agentdock-ui): CLI that copies editable chat components into a React app.

Install the editable chat source in a React app with `npx @agentdock-ai/agentdock-ui add chat`.

Use LangChain provider integrations and LangGraph checkpoint savers directly.
